description: Client-side script for Employee Loan form in ERPNext, handling form queries, button actions, and field toggling.

methods.name: onload
methods.description: Sets query filters for various fields when the form loads.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Adds a custom button for creating disbursement entry based on document status.

methods.name: make_jv
methods.description: Creates a journal entry for the employee loan.

methods.name: mode_of_payment
methods.description: Fetches bank/cash account based on selected mode of payment.

methods.name: employee_loan_application
methods.description: Fetches and sets loan details from an employee loan application.

methods.name: repayment_method
methods.description: Triggers toggling of fields based on repayment method.

methods.name: toggle_fields
methods.description: Enables or disables fields based on repayment method.
